descriptions.devops-pro-linux-docker-kubernetes-ci-cd: This KodeKloud Specialization covers five courses focused on Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
descriptions.ibm-data-science-professional: This IBM Professional Certificate comprises 12 courses covering data science fundamentals, Python, SQL, machine learning, generative AI, and career preparation.
descriptions.ibm-introduction-to-data-science: This IBM Specialization comprises four courses covering foundational data science concepts, tools, methodologies, and SQL databases with Python.
descriptions.google-project-management: This Google Professional Certificate comprises seven courses covering traditional and agile project management.
descriptions.applied-cryptography: This University of Colorado System Specialization comprises four courses covering applied cryptography.
descriptions.ibm-ai-foundations-for-everyone: This IBM Specialization comprises four courses covering the fundamentals of artificial intelligence (AI).
descriptions.ibm-devops-software-engineering: This IBM Professional Certificate comprises 15 courses covering DevOps practices and software engineering.
descriptions.ibm-machine-learning: This IBM Professional Certificate comprises six courses covering machine learning and deep learning.
descriptions.ibm-introduction-to-machine-learning: This IBM Specialization comprises four courses covering the fundamentals of machine learning.
descriptions.pimnas-peserta: Official certificate recognizing participation as a finalist or participant in the 38th National Student Scientific Week (PIMNAS), organized by the relevant Indonesian higher education authorities.
descriptions.pimnas-pendanaan: Certificate documenting funding awarded to the 2025 Student Creativity Program for Innovative Works (PKM-KI), subject to the official certificate wording.
descriptions.bnsp-web-developer: Certificate of Competence issued through LSP Universitas Dian Nuswantoro under the Web Developer competency scheme, within Indonesia's national professional certification framework.
descriptions.bnsp-junior-mobile-programmer: Certificate of Competence issued through LSP Universitas Dian Nuswantoro under the Junior Mobile Programmer competency scheme, within Indonesia's national professional certification framework.
descriptions.apti-pemrograman-web: Professional competency certificate issued through LSP Universitas Dian Nuswantoro in association with the Indonesian Telematics Professional Association (APTI), covering web programming competencies.
